svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · Presets · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift — the grading editor in its own resizable window (PhotoEditorWindowRequest scene in LetsLapseApp; default 1000×700 drawn here, min 720×480; the window chrome owns title and close, so there is no in-content back button or Done bar). REBUILT 2026-09-13 around the editor-controls redesign (Claude Design handoff “LetsLapse Editor slider organization”, boards 3b · 6c; spec sections 1–5, 9, 10): the seven-section always-open panel is gone; the grade is five GROUPS + Presets (App/EditorControls/EditorGroup.swift — Light: Exp · Con / High · Wh / Shad · Bl; Color: WB / Vib · Sat / Mixer; Effects: Tex · Clar / Vignette / Dehaze; Detail: Sharpen / Noise; Crop: aspect chips + Angle), each opened from a main button into ONE card of tool chips over an XY PAD (App/EditorControls/XYPad.swift) with two readouts, and closed by Revert (restores the snapshot taken when the panel opened) or Done (keeps). THIS FILE: the PRESETS group (spec §9) on the interval shoot — a 3-column grid of LIVE thumbnails in the card: the frame under the playhead rendered through each preset (PhotoGrader.render at 160 px, off-main on the grading lane, cached by preset + adjustments token + frame, refreshed on panel open and on gesture end, never per tick). A tile shows the preset ALONE on the frame (a built-in at neutral values; a saved preset as the whole grade it is), not “this preset + my edits” — tapping a built-in REPLACES the edits, so the tile is the tap's honest preview (settled 2026-09-13). Tiles 72 pt tall, radius 10, 8 apart both ways, the name 11 pt semibold white with a shadow bottom-left (7 / 5 in), a 2.5 pt accent ring inside the edge on the applied preset — and on the BASE preset while the state is Edited (settled 2026-09-13, board 3b's rule: `EditorPresetsContext.basePreset`, ringed when `presetState.isEdited` and the tile is that preset; Original rings only while `isOriginal`), so Natural is ringed here under the “Edited” pill — #E9E9EB behind a tile still rendering. Order: the five built-ins (Natural · Cinema · Matte · Vivid · Original) then CustomPresetStore's saved presets (four here, named as the board names them; the bench library had seven); right-click a saved preset for Delete. HEADER: “Presets”, the PresetStatePill (Original / the applied name in accent / “Edited” in a grey capsule, 12.5 pt semibold), the 6 pt dot (lit unless Original), then Revert and Done — no Reset: the card's reset IS the Original tile, and at 274 pt the title, pill, Reset, Revert and Done would not all fit. Under the grid the FOOTER (`presetsFooter`, 2026-09-13): the owner's Lightroom card where a sidecar exists (desc-only), then EITHER the owner's inline “Save these edits as a preset?” offer OR the “Save as Preset” row (square.and.arrow.down, 13 pt semibold accent, names and saves the grade in hand) — never both. The offer stands while the state is Edited and it has not been declined, which is the staged state, so it is what is drawn: a white radius-12 card padded 14 filling the content width (718…992, 139 tall, 10 under the last tile row — 471 here under three rows; the bench capture's four rows put it at 543), title 14.5 pt semibold, the two-sentence body 12.5 pt secondary wrapped to three lines at this width, then “Not now” (14 pt semibold secondary — dismisses the offer, not the editor) and “Save as Preset” (accent) on one row; “Not now” swaps it for the plain row. The offer lives here alone — it no longer follows “Reset adjustments” anywhere in the rail. TIMELINE (6c): with the Editor tab up on an interval shoot the strip leaves the rail and takes a 54 pt row under the media pane — padding 6 top / 16 sides, GradeTimelineView on its COMPACT metrics (26 pt play disc, 12 pt gap, 3 pt rail at primary 18 %, 11 pt moments with the 2 pt #C36A00 ring, 3×20 playhead in #1C1C1E drawn UNDER the moments, the elapsed bubble 8 pt above the row, 10 pt h:mm:ss end labels 2 pt under the track row) and the two 26 pt frame steps 6 apart at the right; on the light surface the discs are #E9E9EB with accent glyphs and the bubble is white with a shadow and black text. Track x=74…609. The INTERVAL badge (EditorMarqueeBadge — kind · length · frame count, 20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold) sits bottom-left of the pane at (12, 12). Staged by LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset: three owned-white moments at 10 / 52 / 86 % (6100 K / 7600 K / 5400 K with Exposure 0 / −0.20 / −0.50, Highlights −0.20 / −0.35 / −0.10, Shadows +0.10 / +0.18 / +0.30, Vibrance +0.12 / +0.38 / +0.10), the playhead at 30 % — so the keyframed fields are whiteMired, exposure, highlights, shadows and vibrance, and the values under the playhead are the eased blend of the first two moments (6715 K, Exposure −0.09, Highlights −27). The clock strings drawn (0:40:12, 2:14:00, 2 h 14 min · 58 frames) are the board's sample data; the 2026-09-13 captures ran on the bench shoot “Stack 2. 9. at 21:03” (1 h 34 min · 5660 frames, playhead 0:28:18). RAIL (3b / 6c): a FIXED 330 pt rail (railWidth, macOS) right of a hairline Divider — resizing the window grows the picture, never the controls. On the Editor page the whole rail scrolls, tab pill included: padding 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between items. Top to bottom: (1) RailTabBar as a white capsule (padding 3, equal segments 2 apart, 13 pt semibold, the selected segment LL.accent with a white label) — Editor · Text · Frames · Masks, Frames only where frames do (availableRailTabs); (2) EditorGroupBar .macCard — a white card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells spread edge to edge: 18 pt SF Symbol (photo.stack, sun.max, circle.lefthalf.filled, sparkles, triangle, crop.rotate), 9.5 pt semibold label, a 4 pt dot lit when the group holds a value or a travelling field, idle ink #6D6D72, the OPEN group on LL.accent 12 % with accent ink; a tap opens that group's panel and snapshots the grade, a tap on the open group leaves it open — closing is the panel's Revert / Done; (3) the open group's PhotoAdjustmentsPanel as a white radius-12 card padded 12 with 10 between rows: the header (title 13.5 semibold #6D6D72, the 6 pt dot when non-neutral, then Reset in accent text while non-neutral, the Revert pill #E9E9EB and the Done pill LL.accent, both 12 pt semibold, 23 tall, radius 7 — Done keeps the values and drops the snapshot, Revert restores it, both close), then the group's content; (4) MasksCard on its compact rows; (5) “Reset adjustments” 13 pt semibold accent, 4 in from the rail's content edge — and nothing after it (the rail-foot repeat of the offer went on 2026-09-13). Group card 62 tall at y=110; the panel card starts at y=184 and, with the offer in its footer under the nine tiles drawn, runs 438 tall to 622, the Masks card at 634 and Reset adjustments at 699 — on the bench library's twelve tiles the same stack runs 71 lower and Reset adjustments drops under the 700 pt fold (the rail scrolls). FIXED 2026-09-13 (was drawn as the board, fix owed): the shipped card had stacked TWO save affordances — the prompt card AND the row (2026-09-13 capture); `presetsFooter` now shows one or the other, and this file draws the offer, which the staged hook shows (mac-presets-v2.png). SETTLED 2026-09-13 (was a deviation, decision owed): the base preset keeps its ring while Edited — the pill still reads “Edited”, since PresetState is Original / named / Edited, but the tile the grade grew from is ringed, as board 3b rings the named preset regardless of edits. STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): the plain “Save as Preset” row (after “Not now”, or when the grade is not Edited); a named preset applied (ring + accent name, the pill in accent); the Original state; a tile mid-render; the Lightroom card; the name alert. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=latest LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=presets. Verified 2026-09-13 against the running Debug build (tile grid, header pill, footer) on Steven's library; re-verified 2026-09-13 after the fixes (ring on Natural, the single offer card, no rail-foot offer — mac-presets-v2.png).
